# Alex Rozgo

> Simulation and AI engineer. Games and simulations for humans, robots and AI agents: building worlds where humans, robots and AI agents learn, play, and evolve together. He worked on AAA console games at LucasArts and across the industry from 2005 to 2015 (including Star Wars: The Force Unleashed), built simulation for robotics and defense from 2016, and developed the simulator shown in Shield AI's Hivemind fixed-wing demo.

Contact: alex.rozgo@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/rozgo. CV: https://rozgo.github.io/Alex-Rozgo-CV.pdf

## Systems

- [Veoveo](https://rozgo.github.io/work/veoveo/): Autonomous operations on infrastructure you own. A self-hosted autonomy harness for physical AI: agents rehearse in simulation, command robots in the field through the same controls, and build their own connectors to new sensors, robots and systems.
- [JEPA world models](https://rozgo.github.io/le-wm-nv/): A Rust and CUDA runtime for JEPA world models. SkyJEPA, rebuilt from its paper, learns how a drone moves and plans its rotor commands, and the JEPA Gym compares model variants on the same drone in MuJoCo. Code: https://github.com/rozgo/le-wm-nv
- [World Sandbox](https://rozgo.github.io/world-sandbox/): Experiments with world models and 3D reconstruction, each with an engineering journal and a replayable 3D viewer. Code: https://github.com/rozgo/world-sandbox
- [MuJoCo Sandbox](https://rozgo.github.io/mujoco-sandbox/): Robots built, broken and measured in simulation, each with an engineering journal. Code: https://github.com/rozgo/mujoco-sandbox
- [Doom Sandbox](https://rozgo.github.io/doom-sandbox/): Language and embedding models playing Doom: a trained ModernBERT classifier, GLiNER2.5 zero-shot and fine-tuned, and EmbeddingGemma 2 reading the screen. Code: https://github.com/rozgo/doom-sandbox
- [Shield AI Hivemind simulator](https://rozgo.github.io/work/shield-ai-simulator/): I developed the simulator shown in Shield AI’s Hivemind fixed-wing demo. Hivemind is Shield AI’s autonomy software for military and commercial aircraft.
- [Maquina](https://rozgo.github.io/work/maquina/): An execution model for simulated worlds. A Lean 4 kernel checks every state change, and each run can be replayed. Agents, people and planners propose actions; the kernel accepts or rejects each one.
- [Axionomy](https://rozgo.github.io/work/axionomy/): A Rust engine that models a problem as accounts, assets and exchanges. Search, optimization and reinforcement learning propose exchanges; the engine validates each one and keeps a replayable trace.
- [AlienWars Gym](https://rozgo.github.io/work/alienwars-gym/): A reinforcement learning and game development harness. Coding, design and NPC agents use it as a world model: they explore procedurally generated 3D worlds in simulation and train policies inside the development loop.
- [Simbotic](https://rozgo.github.io/work/simbotic/): An open-source simulation engine and AI platform for training perception models on synthetic data and testing robots in simulation.

## Recent experiments

- [Synthetic SLAM: a Generated Junkyard Rebuilt in 3D](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TBjPg-n815U) (Oct 2026): Six seconds of AI-generated video from a robot rolling through a junkyard, turned into the camera’s path and a 3D map of the scene.
- [Surgical Thread Robot in MuJoCo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R3CkOR57v4E) (Oct 2026): A learned policy steers a surgical robot that places threads thinner than a human hair into tissue that moves with breathing and pulse, about three times closer to target than the scripted routine it replaced.
- [Adaptive Locomotion](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yv_uwpPm9KQ) (Sep 2026): A quadruped learns to walk by practicing in thousands of simulated worlds at the same time.
- [Rover Swarm over a Degraded LoRa Mesh](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sA_NDf96Dgo) (Sep 2026): Simulated rovers share data over a Reticulum mesh network with heavy packet loss.
- [Fly Flight School](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iAzzoydLlEo) (Sep 2026): A simulated fly learns to fly through the wiring map of a real fly’s brain.
- [AlienWars Game Dev Harness](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ecaXifPN2M) (Sep 2026): A reinforcement learning and game dev harness: coding agents explore a world model in simulation and run reinforcement learning in the loop.
- [ModernBERT Plays Doom](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hXq426rW8gQ) (Sep 2026): A small language model plays Doom in real time, more than twice as fast as the game needs.
- [Amphibious Quadruped in MuJoCo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NMeBjxofL8Y) (Sep 2026): A quadruped with leg-mounted floats walks into water, floats and walks out. Built in 40 minutes from a design posted on LinkedIn.
- [Self-Improving Agent Trains a UAV with JEPA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=300rm4mPcYg) (Sep 2026): An AI agent read a research paper, wrote the code, and trained a drone controller that flies more accurately than the hand-written one.
- [PINO Wind Forecasting for Drone Delivery](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W6TE1dscqE0) (Sep 2026): A drone learns to predict the wind and keeps its package on target in gusts it never trained on.
- [Distributed Quadcopter Simulation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xP0I3b8d3NI) (Sep 2025): A drone simulation split into separate programs that talk to each other, the way software runs on a real robot.
- [Agentic Procedural Augmented Generation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KAEwR96vhnA) (Nov 2024): Text and image prompts drive an agent that generates 3D characters procedurally.

## Writing

- [Maquina: A Theory of Everything for Digital Twins](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/maquina-theory-of-everything-for-digital-twins/) (2025-10-29): Proposes modeling digital twins with three primitives: objects, operations and machines. The idea became the Maquina project.
- [Making the Case for Nash Equilibrium as a Measurement Tool for Virtual Worlds](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/nash-equilibrium-as-a-measurement-tool/) (2025-07-31): Argues for measuring how far a virtual world is from equilibrium instead of designing for perfect balance.
- [Situational Complexity in Massive Simulations](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/situational-complexity-in-massive-simulations/) (2025-04-10): Describes Situation Design: areas of activity with a radius of influence, role slots and growth rules, placed above agents and encounters.
- [Meaning and Memory in Massive Simulations](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/meaning-and-memory-in-massive-simulations/) (2025-02-07): Proposes designing worlds from meanings such as “resting place” and storing memory in places and objects as well as in NPCs.
- [ModernBERT in Game Development](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/modernbert-in-game-development/) (2024-12-20): Where a small encoder model fits in games: classifying player behavior, game state and procedural content.
- [Advanced AI Architectures for Immersive Virtual Worlds](https://rozgo.github.io/writing/ai-architectures-for-virtual-worlds/) (2024-12-16): Actor model, behavior trees, memory systems and language models for agents in virtual worlds.
